items.description: A small settlement on Eleuthera island, known for its annual pineapple festival. It serves as a central hub for the surrounding agricultural community.
A quiet settlement in the Abaco Islands, characterized by its traditional Bahamian architecture and proximity to scenic coastal areas.
A prominent historic structure in Nassau that provides a panoramic vantage point over the city and the surrounding harbor.
A historic limestone fort built in 1793 on Bennet's Hill to protect Nassau from potential invaders.
A naturally occurring stone arch on Eleuthera that serves as a unique geological landmark and a popular stop for travelers.
A historic lighthouse situated on the southern tip of Great Abaco island, marking a notable navigational point for mariners.
A navigational lighthouse located on a private island, serving as a beacon for maritime traffic passing through the Berry Islands.
An island renowned for its unspoiled natural beauty, rolling hills, and the highest point in the Bahamas, Mount Alvernia.
